tablist._doc_enabled: Set false to restore vanilla tablist appearance.
_doc_independentMode: When true (default), NeoEssentials is the sole owner of the tablist.
Proxy integration (BungeeCord/Velocity) is used for data only —
NeoEssentials still renders the header/footer/player-rows itself.
Set false only if you want a proxy-side plugin to own the tablist.
tablist._doc_refreshInterval: How often the tablist header/footer updates, in ticks (20 = 1 s). Lower → smoother animation, more network traffic.
_doc_color_syntax: &k &l &m &n &o &r  — obfuscated, bold, strike, underline, italic, reset
_doc_header: Text displayed ABOVE the player list.
Array → animated frames (one frame shown per refreshInterval ticks).
_doc_footer: Text displayed BELOW the player list. Supports same syntax as header.
_doc_playerFormat: How each player's name appears in the player list rows (via scoreboard teams).
tablist._doc_hideVanished: Hide vanished players from other players' tablists and {online} count. Staff with 'neoessentials.vanish.see' always see them.
tablist._doc_showAfkIndicator: Append afkSuffix to AFK players' names in the tablist.
tablist._doc_afkSuffix: Suffix appended to AFK players' names. Supports all color syntax.
_doc_groupColors: Quick per-group color override for {displayname} in header/footer.
Value is a color prefix prepended to the player's display name.
Supports &#RRGGBB hex.  Use '' (empty string) to disable for a group.
_doc_groups: Players in matching groups see these frames instead of the global ones.
Supports animated arrays and all color syntax.
_doc_players: Per-player header/footer overrides, keyed by player UUID.
These take the highest priority over group and global settings.
Runtime overrides via /tablist player <name> are not persisted here —
add them manually if you want them to survive /tablist reload.
_doc_proxy: Enable when this server runs behind a BungeeCord or Velocity proxy.
Set enabled=true and configure serverLabel with a display name for this server.
_doc_fakePlayers: Use for separator rows, section headers, or padding slots.
Fields: name (display text), latency (ms; -1=no bar), id (unique slot key), listed (show in tab).
Supports all NeoEssentials color/format syntax in 'name'.
_doc_layout: BTLP-inspired tab layout and player-sorting options.
columns: 1–4 visual columns in the tab list.
sortByGroupWeight: sort players by permission group weight (admins first).
groupSections: insert separator rows between permission-group buckets.
playersByServer: group players by proxy server (requires proxy.enabled=true).
excludeServers: server names fully excluded from this tab (no players shown).
hiddenServers: server names whose players are hidden but the server may appear.
maxSlotsPerColumn: slots per column (default 20; 4×20 = 80-slot BTLP grid).
